why: Wikipedia and search results confirm the conjecture remains open with only empirical support and no proof/disproof; a June 2025 arXiv paper (Kovač–Luca, 'On the number of divisors of Mersenne numbers') cites Gillies' probabilistic heuristic but addresses a different Erdős question about unboundedness of divisor-sum ratios f(2n)/f(n), not Gillies' own conjecture on the distribution of prime divisors.
